name: The Year Of Jubilee
overview: The Year of Jubilee, as commanded by the LORD to Moses on Mount Sinai, is a sacred fiftieth year marked by the proclamation of liberty throughout the land, where each person returns to their own possession and family, symbolizing God's provision and restoration. This divine ordinance follows the principle of periodic release, as seen in the seven-year cycle of debt cancellation, emphasizing God's mercy and justice. Isaiah's prophecy echoes this theme by portraying the Messiah as one anointed to proclaim freedom to the captives and healing to the brokenhearted, pointing to the ultimate fulfillment of Jubilee in Christ's redemptive work.
